conflicts.signal: The previous MASTER specification allowed atmospheric glow, glass, and ambient motion.
conflicts.resolution: The new custom Hallmark theme explicitly prohibits those effects; design.md and MASTER.md supersede the old guidance.

conflicts.signal: Atmospheric genre examples may include bloom or translucent layering.
conflicts.resolution: Genre is expressed through depth, scale, and spatial tension only; the project-specific no-glow/no-glass constraint wins.

conflicts.signal: The brief names blue, magenta, and yellow as desired colors while Hallmark favors a controlled accent footprint.
conflicts.resolution: Blue is the structural primary accent; magenta is restricted to Discovery and yellow to Decision/focus semantics.

conflicts.signal: The product is desktop-first but authentication and shell routes can be reached on narrow screens.
conflicts.resolution: Full Workbench composition targets >=1024px; shell and authentication are required to remain usable from 320px through 768px.
